feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 June 2026 10:42pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 04 June 2026 at 10:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure approaching from the west with a deepening area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 later in night or at first tomorrow morning, backing Southwest later in morning. Further backing South or Southeast in afternoon and evening, increasing occasionally 6 in west of area.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, only isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Increasing Southeast 5 to 7 in all waters overnight into Saturday, decreasing 4 or 5 later in morning and early afternoon. Further decreasing 3 or 4 by evening, veering West or Northwest later in evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough overnight, gradually falling slight later on Saturday.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain and drizzle for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.
